content.text: Coningsby arrives at Coningsby Castle, where he meets the Grand Duke, Sidonia, Flora, and the fashionable company. He befriends Flora, debates politics with Sidonia, and wins distinction in a steeple-chase. Sidonia’s history, wealth, Jewish ancestry, travels, and philosophy are recounted. Coningsby studies at Cambridge, then travels to Paris, where he meets Edith Millbank and falls in love, mistakenly believing Sidonia intends to marry her. After witnessing their apparent intimacy, he leaves Paris for England, later visits Edith at Hellingsley, and they confess their love. Millbank, however, reveals his bitter feud with Lord Monmouth and forbids the marriage. Coningsby returns to the Castle with Oswald. Years later, Lord Monmouth summons Coningsby to Monmouth House and asks him to stand as the Conservative candidate for Darlford, despite Millbank’s opposing candidacy.
